content.description: Top view of transmission case showing location of four tubes numbered 1-4

content.text: 13. TURN TRANSMISSION OVER AND REMOVE TUBES
Pry up both tube ends with a large screwdriver and remove the four tubes.

content.description: View of transmission case interior showing solenoid wiring locations and internal components

items: (a) Disconnect connector from the No. 1 and 2 solenoid and the No. 3 solenoid.
(b) Remove the grommet from the transmission case.
(c) Pull the wiring out of the transmission case.

content.description: View of transmission case interior showing valve body with fifteen bolt locations marked
Illustration showing removal of B2 and C2 accumulator piston springs from valve body

items: (b) Remove the B2 and C2 accumulator piston springs.
(c) Disconnect the throttle cable from the cam and remove the valve body.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of throttle cable and retainer using a 10-mm socket to push out plastic retainer

content.text: Using a 10-mm socket, push the plastic throttle cable retainer out of the transmission case.
